versions.content: AUTOSAR shall provide secure access to ECU data and services Type: Valid Description: A UTOSAR shall provide secured access to ECU data and services by secure authentication of external ECU users. For this mechanisms access control decisions need to be enforced. Rationale: Secure access and authentication mechanisms are required for prevention of unauthorized access. Use Case: Secure V2X connection Applies to: AP, CP Dependencies: To fulfill this requirement it is also necessary that the environment that is not standardized by AUTOSAR (e.g. bootloader) matches the sam e security requirements. Supporting Material: --
